key_insight: The paper demonstrates a fully formalized Lean proof of BB84 security, removing hidden assumptions in quantum cryptography proofs and enabling tighter finite-size key-rate analysis.
engineering_relevance: It provides a reproducible framework for verifying quantum communication protocols and shows that LLM-assisted autoformalization can speed both proof development and protocol optimization.
method: Formalized end-to-end composable security for entanglement-based qubit BB84 in Lean
Used the postselection technique to prove security against coherent attacks with finite block-size effects
Applied an LLM-based autoformalization pipeline to build the proof and refine the key-rate bound
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a completed Lean proof of composable security plus a discovery pass that reduced the finite-size penalty on the key rate.
watch_item: Formal proof correctness depends on the fidelity of the Lean model to the physical protocol and on assumptions encoded in the formalization pipeline.
paper_title: Quantum Cryptography and Autoformalization in Lean
